claim: classes.dex defines 353 classes: 18 game shell, 252 OpenFeint, 67 Jackson, 10 commons-codec, 6 google-api-client escape.
observation: dexdump header class_defs_size=353; per-package counts from dexdump class descriptors.
interpretation: Game-specific managed code is 9 real classes + 9 R classes; everything else is third-party middleware.

claim: Exactly 19 methods in the DEX carry ACC_NATIVE, all in package com.sandlotgames.snailmail.
observation: 19 methods with access containing NATIVE; smali `.method ... native` declarations match 1:1.
interpretation: No native methods in OpenFeint/Jackson/codec code; the JNI surface is the game shell only.

claim: The only native-library load in the DEX is System.loadLibrary("snailmail") in SnailMailActivity.<clinit>; no System.load, Runtime.load*, DexClassLoader, PathClassLoader, DexFile, Class.forName, ClassLoader.loadClass anywhere.
observation: Pattern scan of all 353 smali files (managed_shell_scan.json sensitive_api_references) finds 4 hits: loadLibrary (SnailMailActivity:48), Runtime.exec (OpenFeint Util:803), Class.getMethod + Method.invoke (OpenFeint WebNav$ActionHandler:701,713).
interpretation: No dynamic code loading; libsnailmail.so is loaded when SnailMailActivity is first initialised.

claim: OpenFeint WebNav$ActionHandler dispatches web-UI actions by reflection on its own class (getMethod(actionName, Map.class).invoke(this, options)).
observation: invoke-virtual getClass()->getMethod(String, Class[]) then Method.invoke, guarded by mActionList.contains(actionName).
interpretation: Reflection for UI dispatch only, not code loading.

claim: OpenFeint Util.createSymbolic runs Runtime.exec("ln -s <dst> <src>") (called from Util.moveWebCache).
observation: StringBuilder "ln -s " + dst + " " + src passed to Util.run -> Runtime.getRuntime().exec(cmd).
interpretation: Shell process spawn for web-cache symlinks; irrelevant to the port (OpenFeint to be stubbed).

claim: 18 of the 19 declared natives are exported as Java_* symbols in both libraries; SnailMailApplication.JNIOFInit has no export in v7a or v5 and no invoke site in the DEX.
observation: Java_com_sandlotgames_snailmail_SnailMailApplication_JNIOFInit absent from both .dynsym tables; managed scan lists zero invoke sites.
interpretation: Harmless dead declaration (UnsatisfiedLinkError only if called). v5 sha 96dbeaeb20c60d687301ca769656727467371489db5e3ed744a93248bc8d8136 identical result.

claim: Native methods are bound by symbol-name lookup only: no JNI_OnLoad export and no RegisterNatives/GetJavaVM call in either binary.
observation: No JNI_OnLoad symbol; tracked JNIEnv call sites never use offsets 0x35c (RegisterNatives) or 0x36c (GetJavaVM).
interpretation: No JavaVM* is ever obtained, so native code cannot attach threads or re-fetch env.

claim: JAVA_RegisterFunctions stores the raw JNIEnv* and raw thiz local ref into gJavaEnv/gJavaObj and GetObjectClass(thiz) into gJavaClass, with no NewGlobalRef.
location: v7a:0x13ce8 (str env->gJavaEnv), 0x13cec (str thiz->gJavaObj), 0x13cf4 (ldr pc,[env,#0x7c] GetObjectClass), 0x13d10 (str -> gJavaClass); v5:0x14570
observation: GOT slots 0x400/0x2d4/0x1d0 resolve to gJavaEnv 0x91038, gJavaObj 0x9103c, gJavaClass 0x91034 (.bss); only NewGlobalRef site in the binary is in JNIDatInit.
interpretation: Cached local references outlive their native frame (JNI spec violation); cached env is thread-bound.

claim: JAVA_RegisterFunctions calls GetMethodID for 26 records of gJAVAFunction ({jmethodID, name, sig}, 12 bytes each) using gJavaClass; table is 324 bytes with an empty 27th sentinel.
location: v7a:0x13d18-0x13d48 (loop, ldr pc,[r12,#0x84] at 0x13d38); gJAVAFunction v7a:0x8b3f0 size 324; v5:0x946e8
observation: Loop pointer runs table+8 .. table+320 step 12; name/sig pointers are R_ARM_RELATIVE relocated .rodata strings.
interpretation: Method IDs are re-fetched on every nativeInit/nativeReInit.

claim: All 26 gJAVAFunction name/signature pairs match exactly one public instance method of ADRenderer.
observation: Cross-check of table strings against dexdump method list: 26/26 unique matches in both binaries.
interpretation: gJavaObj must be the ADRenderer instance (thiz of nativeInit/nativeReInit).

claim: JAVA_RegisterFunctions is called only by nativeInit and nativeReInit.
location: v7a:0x15658 (bl in nativeInit), v7a:0x155f8 (bl in nativeReInit); v5 same callers
observation: Direct call graph reverse edges of JAVA_RegisterFunctions.
interpretation: Env/obj cache is refreshed on every onSurfaceCreated on the GL thread.

claim: Every Java callback goes through _JNIEnv::CallVoidMethod (CallVoidMethodV, slot 0xf8) or _JNIEnv::CallIntMethod (CallIntMethodV, slot 0xc8) with env=*gJavaEnv and obj=*gJavaObj.
location: helpers v7a:0x13e84 (ldr pc,[r12,#0xf8]) and v7a:0x140e4 (ldr pc,[r12,#0xc8]); 26 helper call sites listed in jni_native_scan.json
observation: Register tracker reports env_source env/gJavaEnv and obj_source glob/gJavaObj at all 26 helper call sites in v7a and v5.
interpretation: Single chokepoint for native->Java; easy to re-implement.

claim: The complete set of JNIEnv functions used by the library is: FindClass, NewGlobalRef, DeleteLocalRef, GetObjectClass, GetMethodID, CallIntMethodV, CallVoidMethodV, GetFieldID, GetIntField, NewStringUTF, GetStringUTFChars, NewByteArray, GetByteArrayRegion, SetByteArrayRegion.
location: jni_native_scan.json jnienv_call_sites (v7a 56 sites, v5 56 sites; plus 26 helper call sites each)
observation: No ExceptionCheck/ExceptionOccurred/ExceptionClear, no ReleaseStringUTFChars, no GetStaticMethodID, no DeleteGlobalRef. Completeness cross-check: every other `ldr pc,[..]`/`blx rN`/`bx rN` in both full disassemblies is a PLT stub, an EHABI unwinder/libgcc helper, the cRHash::Search callback, or a C++ virtual call `ldr pc,[r3]` in engine code.
interpretation: Pending Java exceptions are never detected by native code.

claim: UI/main-thread JNI entries (JNIKey, JNIMouseEvent, JNIAccelerometer, JNIResourceManagerInvalidate, JNIDatInit, JNIDatUnInit, JNIOFOSubmitCB, JNIOFOUnlockCB, JNIOFOInit) cannot reach any gJavaEnv user or GL import.
observation: Their direct-call closures (1-13 functions) contain zero indirect call sites and no gJavaEnv loads or gl* PLT calls, in v7a and v5.
interpretation: No cross-thread use of the cached JNIEnv; cross-thread interaction is limited to plain memory writes.

claim: nativeRender reaches 17 JAVA* wrappers and all GL imports; nativeReInit reaches the texture-load wrappers (JAVAC_UnPng/UnJpg/UnZip, FileSize/FindFile/LoadFile); JNIOFOSave reaches JAVACSaveFile.
location: jni_native_scan.json java_exports (nativeRender 433 functions, 5 indirect sites; nativeReInit 38; JNIOFOSave 6)
observation: Remaining wrappers (Vibrate, OpenFeintOpen, StopMusic, PlayMusic, DeleteFile, LastLoggedInUserID, IsOnline) are reached from address-taken engine AI methods (e.g. cRPlayer::AI) that the game loop calls indirectly.
interpretation: All native->Java callbacks execute on the GL thread.
next_step: Resolve the 5 indirect call sites under nativeRender to confirm the AI dispatch.

claim: JNIDatInit: FindClass("java/io/FileDescriptor"), NewGlobalRef, GetFieldID("descriptor","I"), GetIntField(fd), dup(), fdopen("rb") -> gDatFP; stores start->gJavaAssetStart, length->gJavaAssetLength, dup fd->gJavaAssetFid.
location: v7a:0x15270,0x1528c,0x152b4,0x152ec (JNI), 0x152f0 bl dup@plt, 0x1530c/0x15318/0x15320 stores, 0x15324 bl fdopen@plt, 0x15334 str gDatFP; v5:0x15b5c-0x15bd8
observation: String args resolved by tracker: r1="java/io/FileDescriptor", r2="descriptor", r3="I"; mode string at v7a:0x80e58 = "rb".
interpretation: Archive is read through a private dup'ed descriptor with stdio.

claim: JNIDatInit releases the NewGlobalRef result with DeleteLocalRef.
observation: Second DeleteLocalRef argument is the value returned by NewGlobalRef.
interpretation: JNI misuse: the global ref leaks and CheckJNI-enabled runtimes may report an error.
next_step: Observe under -Xcheck:jni on a 32-bit device/emulator if available.

claim: JNIDatInit reads a 244-byte probe at the asset start, allocates the directory (size = probe u32 at +8), re-reads it from the start, then rewrites the u32 at archive offset 4+24*i (record i's name_offset in docs/ASSET_FORMATS.md) into an absolute 32-bit pointer before hashing it; count = u32 at offset 0.
observation: fseek(start); fread(sp+12,1,244); RShellMemoryMalloc([sp+0x14]); fseek(start); fread(gDat,1,size); loop p=gDat+24*i: [p+4]+=gDat; cRHash::Add(&gDatHash,[p+4],i) while i < *(int*)gDat.
interpretation: Directory relocation assumes 32-bit pointers (arm64 hazard). Consistent with docs/ASSET_FORMATS.md section 2 (asset workstream owns the format).

claim: JNIDatUnInit only calls wprintf twice, and native wprintf is a no-op; the archive is never closed.
location: v7a:0x13c70-0x13c94; wprintf v7a:0x19948 (push {r0-r3}; add sp,#16; bx lr)
observation: No fclose/close/free in JNIDatUnInit.
interpretation: onStop->onRestart keeps working without re-init.

claim: JNIDebug returns constant 0 in both builds, so SnailMailActivity.wprintf never prints.
observation: wprintf prints only if JNIDebug()==1.
interpretation: Managed debug logging permanently off.

claim: SnailMailActivity.onCreate order: ActivityInitFlag=true; wprintf x2; newWakeLock(26,"DoNotDimScreen"); super.onCreate; requestWindowFeature(1); getWindow().setFlags(1024,1024); super.onCreate (again); new ADGLSurfaceView(this); setContentView; AudioInitFlag=true; new SoundPool(8,3,0); openFd("asm.mp3") -> JNIDatInit; new AccelerometerListener(this).start().
observation: Instruction order in smali; 0x1a=26=PowerManager.FULL_WAKE_LOCK (deprecated since API 17), feature 1=FEATURE_NO_TITLE, 0x400=FLAG_FULLSCREEN, SoundPool(maxStreams 8, STREAM_MUSIC 3, srcQuality 0).
interpretation: Matches JADX output.

claim: super.onCreate(savedInstanceState) is invoked twice in onCreate (before and after requestWindowFeature/setFlags).
observation: Two invoke-super Activity.onCreate instructions.
interpretation: Original-code quirk confirmed (not a JADX artefact).

claim: asm.mp3 start offset and length are narrowed with long-to-int before JNIDatInit; the AssetFileDescriptor is never closed; IOException is caught and only logged.
observation: getStartOffset()J -> long-to-int v5; getLength()J -> long-to-int v3; no close() on v0.
interpretation: Works because asm.mp3 is stored uncompressed (inventory compress=stored; .mp3 is in aapt's no-compress list).

claim: ADGLSurfaceView.onTouchEvent maps ACTION_DOWN(0)->JNIMouseEvent(0), ACTION_UP(1)->JNIMouseEvent(2), ACTION_MOVE(2)->JNIMouseEvent(1); all other actions do nothing; always returns true.
location: work/apktool/smali/com/sandlotgames/snailmail/ADGLSurfaceView.smali:303-394; classes.dex packed-switch payload at file offset 0x0266dc
observation: Payload ident 0x0100 size 3 first_key 0 targets +4,+0x1d,+0x11 from 0x0005 -> 0x09 (const 0), 0x22 (const 2), 0x16 (v4=1).
interpretation: Confirms JADX despite its 'incorrect switch cases order' warning.

claim: Native JNIMouseEvent: returns unless gGameValid; X=x*640/gG0DeviceScreenWidth, Y=y*480/gG0DeviceScreenHeight; type 0 -> ClickiPhone(true,X,Y)+ClickOn; type 1 -> ClickiPhone only when *(Game+0x718fc)==2, then ClickOn; otherwise ClickOff.
observation: x arrives in r3 and y on the stack (softfp).
interpretation: Input is normalised to a 640x480 virtual screen.

claim: onKeyDown: BACK with repeatCount 0 returns true without super; otherwise (getAction()==ACTION_DOWN) keycodes 29-54, 7-16, 62, 67, 66 call JNIKey (66 also hides the IME); super.onKeyDown's result is returned for every non-BACK path.
observation: packed-switch with the single key 0; all branches fall to :goto_1 invoke-super.
interpretation: BACK key is swallowed by the view (likely prevents exiting via BACK); DPAD keys are only logged.

claim: Native JNIKey converts A-Z via cKeyPad::ConvertCode((char)(keycode+68)), 0-9 via ConvertCode((char)(keycode+41)), SPACE->57, ENTER->28, DEL->14 and calls KeySet only when *(int*)(Game+0xbf0)==2.
observation: Other keycodes reach KeySet with uninitialised r4 (not reachable from Java).
interpretation: 57/28/14 equal DirectInput DIK_SPACE/DIK_RETURN/DIK_BACK (intent is a hypothesis).
next_step: v5 mapping not re-derived by hand.

claim: AccelerometerListener: x*x+y*y+z*z in float, sqrt in double, n==0 -> 1.0, divisions in double narrowed to float, low-pass last+=(cur-last)*0.3f in float, JNIAccelerometer(-last_x,-last_y,last_z); registerListener(listener, first TYPE_ACCELEROMETER sensor, rate 0 = SENSOR_DELAY_FASTEST); stop() is never invoked.
observation: mul-float/add-float then float-to-double; div-double; double-to-float; const 0x3e99999a; neg-float on x,y only.
interpretation: Matches JADX. Listener leaks across Activity recreation.

claim: Native JNIAccelerometer forwards (x,y,z) to cAccelerometer::Input(Game+0xbd4) when Game != NULL.
observation: z taken from the stack (softfp).
interpretation: Pure state write.

claim: ADRenderer.JAVATime stores System.nanoTime() in static long JTime and returns (int)JTime; JAVATimeHi returns (int)(JTime >> 32) using shr-long by 32 then long-to-int.
observation: sput-wide/sget-wide JTime; const/16 v2,0x20; shr-long/2addr; long-to-int.
interpretation: Arithmetic shift; low word is the raw low 32 bits.

claim: Native JAVATime() calls JAVATime then JAVATimeHi and returns ((uint64)hi<<32 | (uint32)lo)/1000 via __aeabi_uldivmod (microseconds); GetTime() tail-calls it and callers consume both r0 and r1.
location: v7a:0x14118-0x1417c; GetTime v7a:0x7d110; caller appRender v7a:0x156c0-0x156d8; v5:0x149cc-0x14a30
observation: orr r0,r6(=0),r4(lo); mov r1,r7(hi); r2=1000,r3=0; bl __aeabi_uldivmod.
interpretation: Engine time base is uint64 microseconds of CLOCK_MONOTONIC-derived nanoTime.

claim: JAVAUnPng/JAVAUnJpg decode with BitmapFactory.decodeByteArray(src, 0, src.length, opts{inDither=true, inPreferredConfig=ARGB_8888}) and copy with Bitmap.copyPixelsToBuffer(ByteBuffer.wrap(dst)).
observation: No null check on the decoded bitmap.
interpretation: Output is the raw ARGB_8888 pixel memory (RGBA byte order).

claim: Native JAVAC_UnPng/UnJpg allocate dst/src byte arrays, upload src with SetByteArrayRegion, call the Java decoder, then copy row i of the Java buffer to dst+(h-1-i)*(dstLen/h) with GetByteArrayRegion (vertical flip); the width argument is unused.
observation: rowBytes = __divsi3(dstLen, h); loop offsets i*rowBytes and dst + (h-1)*rowBytes - i*rowBytes.
interpretation: Pixel rows are stored bottom-up.

claim: PfmLoadFileDat dispatches on a type argument (0 raw read, 1 JAVAC_UnZip, 2 JAVAC_UnJpg, 3 JAVAC_UnPng) and for images writes an 18-byte TGA header (image type 2, 32 bpp, descriptor 8, width/height) before the pixels.
location: v7a:0x14cb4-0x14ccc (jump table), 0x14d28-0x14d74 (header stores), fseek offset base gJavaAssetStart 0x14cd8-0x14cf8
observation: strb 2 @+2, strh w @+12, strh h @+14, strb 32 @+16, strb 8 @+17; decode target dst+18.
interpretation: Decoded images are presented to the engine as bottom-up 32-bit TGA.

claim: JAVAUnZip inflates only the first ZIP entry, copies bytewise into Buffer until read()==-1, swallows all exceptions (including ArrayIndexOutOfBounds) and does not close the stream on error.
observation: Single getNextEntry(); do/while(read != -1); catch Exception -> wprintf.
interpretation: Oversized entries are silently truncated.

claim: Native JAVAC_UnZip(dst,dstLen,src,srcLen): NewByteArray(dstLen), NewByteArray(srcLen), SetByteArrayRegion(src), CallVoidMethod(JAVAUnZip,dstArr,srcArr), GetByteArrayRegion(dstArr,0,dstLen,dst), DeleteLocalRef x2.
interpretation: Output length is whatever native requested.

claim: Native passes pointers into gOFOData as the int CBOFOStatePtr: OFAddArcade passes gOFOData+360*cur+0x10c; OFAddAchievement passes gOFOData+360*cur+0x144+idx; the byte is set to 1 before submission.
observation: add r2,r5,#268 / add r1,r7,#324 then tail-call JAVAOpenFeintSubmit/Unlock; strb 1 before.
interpretation: A 32-bit address round-trips through Java int.

claim: Java forwards CBOFOStatePtr unchanged: SubmitToCB.onSuccess -> JNIOFOSubmitCB(ptr), onFailure -> JNIOFOSubmitCB(0); UnlockCB.onSuccess -> JNIOFOUnlockCB(ptr), onFailure -> (0); LoadCB.onSuccess -> unlock or JNIOFOUnlockCB(ptr) if already unlocked; LoadCB has no onFailure override (APICallback.onFailure is empty).
interpretation: Achievement load failure never reaches native code.

claim: JNIOFOSubmitCB/JNIOFOUnlockCB: if ptr != 0 store byte 2 at ptr; always set gOFOSaveFlag=1.
observation: cmp r5,#0; movne r3,#2; strbne r3,[r5]; strb 1 -> GOT 0x258 (gOFOSaveFlag).

claim: Native only submits scores/unlocks when OFIsUserLoggedIn() (JAVAOpenFeintIsUserLoggedIn) returns true; otherwise it just sets gOFOSaveFlag.
observation: bl OFIsUserLoggedIn; cmp r0,#0; bne submit path.
interpretation: With OpenFeint servers gone no user can log in, so the pointer-callback path is dormant.

claim: OpenFeint request completions run on the Handler created in the Client and OpenFeintInternal constructors, which run inside OpenFeint.initialize from SnailMailApplication.onCreate (main thread).
observation: Executor thread runs the HTTP request then posts onResponse to mMainThreadHandler.
interpretation: JNIOFOSubmitCB/UnlockCB/JNIOFOInit run on the main thread.
next_step: Rare synchronous failure paths (OpenFeintInternal null, null resourceID, cached unlock) run on the caller's thread.

claim: JNIOFOInit calls GetStringUTFChars(userID, NULL) and never releases it, then OFONewUser strcpy's into gOFUser and gConfig+240 and sets gOFOLoadFlag.
observation: No ReleaseStringUTFChars (slot 0x2a8) anywhere in the binary.
interpretation: UTF chars leak per login; unbounded copy.

claim: JAVAOpenFeintLastLoggedInUserID receives a 64-byte array from native and writes userID bytes plus a NUL without a bounds check; native copies back with GetByteArrayRegion and falls back to gConfig+240 when empty.
interpretation: Overflow would leave an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException pending in native code.

claim: onSurfaceCreated calls nativeInit the first time in the process (static SurfaceCreatedFirstTime) and nativeReInit afterwards, plus JNIAudioInit when AudioInitFlag is set (only onCreate sets it).
observation: SurfaceCreatedFirstTime set true after nativeInit; AudioInitFlag cleared after first init and after JNIAudioInit.
interpretation: A new Activity instance in an old process goes straight to nativeReInit.

claim: nativeInit = JAVA_RegisterFunctions + cRResourceManager::Init(&gResourceManager) + G0StartBlackCount=2; nativeReInit = JAVA_RegisterFunctions + InitGL + cRResourceManager::ReInit + *(Game+0x718b4)=4 + G0StartBlackCount=2.
nativeRender(flag) runs AppInit() every frame and, if it returns non-zero, appRender(flag != 0); onDrawFrame passes 1 when SnailMailActivity.HasFocus is false.
nativeResize(w,h) stores (float)w into gG0DeviceScreenWidth and gG0ScreenWidth and (float)h into gG0DeviceScreenHeight and gG0ScreenHeight.
interpretation: No GL calls in the resize entry itself.

claim: JNIAudioInit is bx lr; nativeDone calls appDeinit and importGLDeinit which are both bx lr; nativePause and nativeDone have no invoke site in the DEX.
interpretation: Dead or no-op JNI surface.

claim: JNIResourceManagerInvalidate -> cRResourceManager::Invalidate sets gLoadingBar byte +0x35 to 1 and field +8 of each 140-byte resource record to 1; no GL or JNI calls.
interpretation: Marks GL resources for reload after the context is lost.

claim: Lifecycle bodies: onPause = mGLView.onPause, wl.release, JNIResourceManagerInvalidate, MusicPlayer.pause if playing, super.onPause; onResume = super, mGLView.onResume, wl.acquire; onStop = Sp.release, Sp=null, JNIDatUnInit, super; onRestart = new SoundPool(8,3,0), super; onStart/onDestroy = log + super.
interpretation: Matches JADX.

claim: The GL thread is created by GLSurfaceView.setRenderer inside the ADGLSurfaceView constructor, which runs in onCreate before JNIDatInit; Renderer callbacks only start after the window surface exists (after onResume).
observation: setRenderer precedes openFd/JNIDatInit in program order on the UI thread.
interpretation: JNIDatInit returns before surfaceCreated can be delivered, so nativeInit happens after it.
next_step: Relies on documented GLSurfaceView/ViewRootImpl behaviour; confirm with a device trace.

claim: onRestart creates a new SoundPool while sample IDs obtained from the released pool remain in native state; no Java-side reload exists and nativeReInit does not reach JAVALoadSample.
interpretation: Sound effects may be silent after stop/restart unless the engine reloads samples.
next_step: Check cRSound/RShell sample cache for reload logic; test on device.

claim: JAVALoadSample and JAVAPlayMusic open an AssetFileDescriptor per call and never close it.
interpretation: fd leak per sample/music load.

claim: Manifest: package com.sandlotgames.snailmail, versionCode 1, versionName 1.00, installLocation auto, minSdkVersion 6, no targetSdkVersion, application SnailMailApplication, launcher SnailMailActivity (screenOrientation landscape, configChanges keyboardHidden|orientation 0xa0), 4 OpenFeint activities, 6 permissions, glEsVersion 0x10001, accelerometer+touchscreen required, supports-screens small/normal/large/anyDensity.

APK is signed with v1 (JAR) only; signer CN=Daniel Berstein, O=Sandlot Games, RSA 1024, sha1WithRSA, cert SHA-256 5b3cca3a9cb98df1c410e9ee5f948a8dc2910bfd761455baf8e2d820eeb8ac3b, valid 2011-02-23 to 2036-02-17.
location: META-INF/CERT.RSA, CERT.SF, MANIFEST.MF (apksigner verify --print-certs; openssl pkcs7)
observation: MANIFEST.MF lists 236 entries with SHA1-Digest.

claim: No nested payloads outside assets/lib/dex: the 6 OpenFeint doc-files PNGs are well-formed (IEND last, 0 trailing bytes), the 10 doc .htm/.lbi files are text (only UTF-8 punctuation), res JPEG has 0 bytes after EOI, and no ZIP/ELF/DEX/Ogg magic occurs inside any such entry.
interpretation: doc-files are SDK documentation bundled by accident.

claim: OpenFeint product name/key/secret/app id are embedded as static final strings in SnailMailApplication.
observation: Values intentionally not reproduced in docs.
interpretation: Credentials for a defunct service; must not be reused in a port.

claim: OpenFeint base URL is hard-coded as https://api.openfeint.com.
interpretation: The OpenFeint service was shut down (external fact, Dec 2012); all requests fail today.

claim: PfmLoadFileDat seeks to gJavaAssetStart + record offset, so archive offsets are relative to the asset's start inside the APK.
observation: ldr gJavaAssetStart; add r1,r10,r1; bl fseek@plt.
interpretation: 32-bit start offset.

claim: Both libraries carry DT_TEXTREL and DT_SYMBOLIC and import no __android_log_*, dlopen or dlsym although liblog/libdl are NEEDED.
interpretation: Informational for the platform workstream.

claim: Native-side wprintf is a no-op in both builds, so all native debug strings are dead.
location: v7a:0x19948; v5 wprintf 0x1b724 called from JNIOFOSubmitCB

claim: HasFocus is written on the UI thread and read by onDrawFrame on the GL thread; AudioInitFlag written on UI, read/cleared on GL; SnailMailActivity.ActivityInitFlag is written but never read; ADRenderer.ActivityInitFlag is only initialised.
observation: All are plain (non-volatile) static fields.
interpretation: Benign data races; port should use atomics.

claim: JAVAPlaySample calls SoundPool.play(id, vol, vol, 1, 0, 1.0f); PfmAudioPlaySample scales vol by PfmSampleVolume and passes it to CallIntMethod as a double vararg.
Bitmap.copyPixelsToBuffer on an ARGB_8888 bitmap yields bytes in R,G,B,A order with premultiplied alpha.
observation: Not observable in these bytes; Android platform behaviour.
interpretation: Any native PNG/JPEG replacement must produce premultiplied RGBA to match original rendering.
next_step: Validate with an on-device capture of a decoded texture.

claim: JNIOFOSave (only called by ADRenderer.JAVAOpenFeintOpen) branches to OFOSave: if gOFOValid, gRegisterSaveFile("of.cfg", gOFOData, 11520).
interpretation: Runs re-entrantly on the GL thread.

claim: JAVASaveFile writes with Context.openFileOutput(name, MODE_PRIVATE); JAVAFileSize uses FileInputStream.available(); JAVALoadFile does a single read(Data,0,length).
interpretation: Saves live in the app-private files dir.

claim: JAVAPlayMusic creates a new MediaPlayer each call without releasing a previous one, prepares synchronously, loops, and applies MusicVolume.
interpretation: Relies on native calling JAVAStopMusic first.

claim: JADX adds 'throws' clauses (e.g. onCreate throws IOException, onPause throws IllegalStateException) that do not exist in the DEX; otherwise the JADX output of all 9 non-R game-shell classes matches smali control flow.
observation: Manual side-by-side comparison.
interpretation: Cosmetic decompiler artefact only.

claim: OpenFeint.initialize posts login(); with no saved user launchIntroFlow() only fires after a successful /xp/devices device-session request.
interpretation: With the servers gone the IntroFlow Activity should never appear.

claim: JNIMouseEvent/JNIAccelerometer receive float arguments in core registers and on the stack (armeabi softfp), and the Call*Method varargs pass float as double.
interpretation: Only relevant for hand-written glue; C prototypes handle it on arm64.
